mg.k.description: Your spells strike harder and cost less, but blows strike you a little harder.
mg.k.name: Atronach's Pact

mg.lk.description: Every craft of the workshop teaches you more.
mg.lk.name: Scholar's Seclusion

rt.k.description: Your wounds close of their own accord, but your weapons and spells are a little weaker.
rt.k.name: Martyr's Vow

rt.lk.description: The wilds give up every leaf to you, and your kitchen makes the most of them.
rt.lk.name: Hermit's Covenant

sh.k.description: Blows against the unwary are deadly. In open battle your weapons are a little weaker.
sh.k.name: Night Mother's Embrace

sh.lk.description: Every merchant in the Iliac Bay knows your name, and every noble house your manners.
sh.lk.name: Merchant Prince

st.k.description: You strike fast and hard, and leave yourself a little open.
st.k.name: Steed's Charge

st.lk.description: Your ship answers the wind as no other, and the sea gives up its fish to you.
st.lk.name: Master and Commander

th.k.description: Blows often miss you entirely, but heavy armor sits poorly on you.
th.k.name: Wind Runner

th.lk.description: The finest hides are yours, and every kill teaches you more.
th.lk.name: Lord of the Hunt

wr.k.description: Below half Health you strike far harder, though your armor guards you a little less.
wr.k.name: Berserker's Fury

wr.lk.description: Stone and timber yield more to your pick and axe.
wr.lk.name: Stonebreaker's Oath
